ruleDefinitions.name: Scripting/CommandLine Process Spawned Regsvr32
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects various command line and scripting engines/processes such as "PowerShell", "Wscript", "Cmd", etc. spawning a "regsvr32" instance.

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd\.exe" AND process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\/s\\ C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\RpcProxy\\\\RpcProxy\\\.dll$")))
